title: Useless Borders
text:
a place

I do not say a space

I speak of

what


I speak of what is not

I speak of what I know


not time

only all the instants

not love

no

yes

no


a place of absence

a thread of miserable union.
editorial_note: The translation preserves the poem's stammering negations and minimal architecture.

title: Song
text:
time is afraid

fear has time

fear


walks through my blood

tears out my best fruits

devastates my pitiful wall


destruction of destructions

only destruction


and fear

so much fear

fear
editorial_note: The translation keeps the circular exchange between time and fear.

title: My Wings?...
text:
My wings?

two rotten petals

my reason?

little cups of sour wine

my life?

a well-considered void

my body?

a gash in the chair

my rocking?

a childish gong

my face?

a disguised zero

my eyes?

ah! pieces of infinity
editorial_note: The question-and-answer form is kept abrupt, with each image left bare.

title: Meaning of His Absence
text:
if I dare

to look and to speak

it is because of his shadow

joined so softly

to my name

far away

in the rain

in my memory

because of his face

which, burning in my poem,

beautifully scatters

a perfume

O beloved vanished face
editorial_note: The translation keeps the syntax of dependence: speech becomes possible only through the absent face.

title: This Untimely Storm, These Bars in the Pupils of My...
text:
This untimely storm, these bars in the pupils of my

eyes, this little love story closing like a

fan that, open, showed the hallucinated beauty: the most

naked one in the forest in the musical silence of embraces.
editorial_note: The broken title and lineation are preserved to keep the sentence's interrupted pressure.

title: The Works and the Nights
text:
to recognize in thirst my emblem

to signify the only dream

to never again sustain myself on love


I have been all offering

a pure wandering

of she-wolf in the forest

in the night of bodies


to speak the innocent word
editorial_note: The title echoes Pizarnik's nocturnal labor, while the infinitives remain ritual and unresolved.

title: Room Alone
text:
If you dare to surprise

the truth of this old wall;

and its fissures, tears,

forming faces, sphinxes,

hands, clepsydras,

surely a presence will come

for your thirst,

probably this absence

that drinks you will depart.
editorial_note: Clepsydras is kept for the wall's archaic, dreamlike inventory.

title: I Am in Dread...
text:
I am in dread.

what I most feared has come over me.

I am not in difficulty:

I am at the end of my strength.


I did not abandon the void and the desert.

I live in danger.


your song does not help me.

more and more pincers,

more fears,

more black shadows.
editorial_note: The translation preserves the lowercase pressure and the escalation from difficulty to exhaustion.
